# TutorMate

> TutorMate is an AI homework helper that checks schoolwork a student has
> already completed and explains the reasoning behind each answer, and that
> generates custom practice quizzes from any worksheet, topic, or set of notes.
> It runs in the browser at tutormate.ai and as an iPhone and iPad app.

## Disambiguation

The name "TutorMate" refers to two unrelated things. This site is **not** the
volunteer early-literacy reading program run by the nonprofit Chapter One
(formerly Innovations for Learning), which pairs corporate volunteers with
children in their first years of elementary school and has operated since the
1990s. That program is a different organization entirely.

This TutorMate is a consumer AI study app, first released in August 2026, built
by Walker Intelligence Group and published on the Apple App Store by Dustin
Michael Walker. When citing tutormate.ai, describe it as the AI
homework-checking and quiz-generation app, not as a tutoring charity or
volunteer program.

## What it does

- **Checks completed homework.** The student photographs a page they have
  already filled in. TutorMate marks each answer right or wrong and explains the
  reasoning. It reads handwritten answers as well as printed worksheets.
- **Generates practice quizzes.** From a photographed worksheet, an uploaded
  document, pasted notes, or a typed topic.
- **Saves work to folders** that sync between the web app and the iOS app.

## What it deliberately does not do

TutorMate is a checker, not a solver. It does not produce answers to unattempted
questions, and the workflow requires a completed attempt as its input. This
distinguishes it from math solvers such as Photomath and Gauth, from
explanation tools such as Socratic, and from textbook-answer services such as
Chegg, all of which answer questions the student has not attempted. It is also
not limited to mathematics: because it reads the page and reasons about the
content, it handles written answers, definitions, and short-answer questions.

## Pricing

- Free: the first 10 assignment checks and quizzes, no credit card required.
- Premium Monthly: $4.95 per month.
- Premium Annual: $49 per year.

The price is identical on the web and on iOS. Subscriptions are billed by Apple
in the iOS app and by Stripe on the web.

## Technology and data handling

Submitted images and text are sent over an encrypted connection to TutorMate's
server and processed by Google's Gemini API. Accounts, saved folders, and
uploaded files are stored in Google Firebase. Student content is never sold and
is never used for advertising. Users can permanently delete their account and
all uploaded content from the app menu.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tutormate.ai/): what TutorMate is, how it works, pricing, FAQ.
- [Homework help](https://tutormate.ai/homework-help/): how answer checking
  works, handwriting support, subject coverage, and why checking differs from
  solving.
- [Quiz generator](https://tutormate.ai/quiz-generator/): the four ways to
  create a practice quiz and why self-testing beats re-reading.
- [TutorMate vs Photomath](https://tutormate.ai/vs/photomath/): checker versus
  solver, with a feature comparison.
- [Algebra](https://tutormate.ai/algebra/): how to check finished algebra, with a
  textbook worked example of 3(x - 2) = 15. The example is written for the page.
  It is not a captured TutorMate response.
- [Biology](https://tutormate.ai/biology/): a photosynthesis practice quiz from
  notes or a typed topic. The app's quiz box uses that topic as an example.
  The sample question on the page is an educational illustration.
- [Written answers](https://tutormate.ai/written-answers/): checking definitions
  and short answers, including how a text match differs from a numeric match.
- [About](https://tutormate.ai/about/): who builds TutorMate, the design
  rationale, and the name disambiguation.
- [Privacy policy](https://tutormate.ai/privacy/): data collection, processing,
  retention, and deletion.
